newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia coffee prices stable, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia coffee prices stable, trade thin.

text.p: Indonesian Robusta coffee prices were generally stable on Monday from a week ago with only a handful of exporters with outstanding contracts prowling the market for supplies, traders said.
They said the local price was quoted at 2,600-50 rupiah/kg in the key growing region of Lampung in South Sumatra, unchanged from a week ago.
The export price was also generally stable at $1,118/tonne fob Lampung against $1,116-17 last week.
"There are some players who are covering to fulfill their contracts but the trade has generally been quiet," one said.
